caption: Figure 2. Extensions to the UART Specification. On top of the base specification from Figure 1a, this adds Reset to cancel in-flight operations and Config for baud rate.
subject: how CPU writes to RESET, DATA and CONFIG plus hardware queue events drive UART states between Idle, Busy and QueueFull

groups.why_chosen: A CPU-triggered write to DATA is checked by hardware against STATUS::FULL to decide whether the queue moves to Busy or QueueFull; RESET forces Idle from anywhere, and CONFIG may only be touched while Idle.
groups.what_to_learn: a two-colour solid/dashed arrow convention distinguishing software-triggered from hardware-triggered transitions; a nested dotted substate box inside a solid superstate box to show refinement without adding a new top-level state; a small legend box inside the diagram itself explaining the arrow-colour convention
